# Turtle Transformation Limited (The Authentic Leader Academy)

> The Authentic Leader Academy by Turtle Transformation Limited empowers senior directors, C-suite executives, and technology founders to transition from reactive operational firefighting to grounded, calm, and high-leverage leadership.

## Core Philosophy
- "Slow is smooth, and smooth is fast."
- "Change from the inside to the outside."
- Core belief: Real executive performance does not come from superficial productivity tools, but from somatic emotional regulation, nervous system resilience, and authentic human connection.

## Founders
- **Miriam Schmidberger**: Co-founder, Change Angel & Performance Coach, AQai Certified Adaptability Coach, Unbeatable Mind & Heroic Certified Coach, Master Yoga Alliance Teacher, Keynote Speaker at Greator Festival 2024. Specializes in emotional digestion, somatic stress regulation, and Parts Work.
- **Dr. Markus Schmidberger**: Co-founder, PhD in Technical Mathematics & Bioinformatics, former Director of Data at Scout24 Group, former Senior Big Data Consultant at Amazon Web Services (AWS) ProServe, CTO, Life Trust Coach. Specializes in enterprise Data & AI strategy, scaling high-performance engineering teams, and executive advisory.

## Core Offerings

### 1. 12-Month High Performance Executive Coaching (with Miriam Schmidberger)
- **Target Audience**: Senior directors, VPs, C-suite executives, tech leaders, and ambitious founders.
- **Duration**: 12 Months.
- **Cadence**: 1x 60-min strategic deep-dive session + 1x 30-min operational application session per month.
- **Baseline Diagnostic Assessments**: AQai Adaptability Assessment and Five-Mountain Leadership Assessment (Physical, Mental, Emotional, Intuition, Kokoro).
- **Core Pillars**: Cognitive Restructuring, Somatic Stress Regulation & Parts Work, High-Impact Dialogue (NVC), Team Psychological Safety.
- **Pricing**: €4,700 total (payable in two milestones of €2,350 with a formal 6-month progress audit).
- **Optional Retainer**: €280/month for dedicated asynchronous WhatsApp voice/text support (Mon–Thu) for real-time crisis resolution.
- **Application & Contact**: Direct email to info@turtletrafo.de

### 2. Enterprise Data & AI Consulting (with Dr. Markus Schmidberger)
- **Target Audience**: Enterprises, scale-ups, and technology organizations seeking executive guidance on generative AI, data platform architecture, and scaling engineering cultures.
- **Core Pillars**: Data & AI Strategy Roadmaps, High-Performance Tech Team Scaling, Interim CTO / Board Advisory.
- **Inquiries**: Direct email to info@turtletrafo.de
